target: Validate a claim about transfer learning using a source-to-target adaptation study. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

competency.title: Validate transfer learning — independent holdout
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about transfer learning using a source-to-target adaptation study. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

topic_kernel.measure: target sample efficiency and negative transfer
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: using overlapping source and target items

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a source-to-target adaptation study.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report target sample efficiency and negative transfer with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: using overlapping source and target items.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of transfer learning.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report target sample efficiency and negative transfer against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for using overlapping source and target items; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
